title: Control flow [switch (fallthrough)]
description:
## Intentional Fallthrough
Sometimes fallthrough is useful! When multiple cases should do the same thing, you can stack them:
```ts
switch (day) {
    case "Saturday":
    case "Sunday":
        console.log("Weekend!");
        break;
    default:
        console.log("Weekday");
}
```
Both Saturday and Sunday hit the same code. No duplication needed.
